{{Quote|Why should I accept death for myself and my city merely because the Queen of the White has arisen?|The Queen of the Red|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />|translated=!}}
The '''Queen of the White''' was a title held by the one of the three [[Queen of the Quesoth|Queens of the Quesoth]], the rulers of the [[Quesoth]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], the<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} — Based on corresponding data for [[Quethold system/Legends|Quethold system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]]. The Quesoth underwent a cycle whereby the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of the White would reign from Quethold's [[White City]] for a number of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] until [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Death/Legends|death]]. She would then be replaced by the [[Queen of the Black]] and once the Queen of the Black died, the [[Queen of the Red]] would emerge. While the Queen of the Red ruled Quethold, the [[Circling of the White]], a Quesoth caste of [[Reproduction/Legends|breeders]] and advisers, would [[Reproduction/Legends|breed]] a new Queen of the White to continue the cycle.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> the [[Queen of the Red (8 ABY)|reigning]] Queen of the Red allied herself with the [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]], who would help her murder the Queen of the White to prevent her predecessor's fall from power. However, before the pair could enact their plan, they were killed during an [[Attack on the Red City|attack]] on Quethold by the forces of the [[Empire of the Hand]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
